verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a public API, with API-key management and an API docs article. It lets code search 138M+ papers, generate research reports, and run a full systematic review end to end with control over search, screening, extraction and reporting. It is listed as 'API access' on the pricing page, and all API functionality is also exposed via an MCP server. The OpenAPI probe 404s were only on the support-site domain, so they are a documentation gap, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable spec or endpoint-level reference in evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
